content.title: Do offers aa gaye?
content.subtitle: Sirf naam aur ranking se decide mat karo.

steps.title: Total kharcha
steps.detail: Tuition ke saath rent, khaana aur travel. Poore course ka hisaab lagao.

steps.title: Scholarship ya funding
steps.detail: Kis offer mein kitni madad mil rahi hai? Wo kharche mein se ghatao.

steps.title: Course modules
steps.detail: Jo subjects aapko chahiye, wo kahan zyada hain? Dono syllabus saath rakh ke dekho.

steps.title: City aur rehna
steps.detail: Mausam, rent aur rehne ka mahaul. Wahan ke seniors se baat karo.

steps.title: Deposit ki deadline
steps.detail: Kis offer ko kab tak confirm karna hai? Galti se koi offer expire na ho.
steps.tip: Ek simple table banao: offer, kharcha, funding, deadline.
